subtitle: A fish for your cat to catch
promotionalText: A free, ad-free fish for your cat to chase. It swims, hovers and darts around the screen, and when a paw lands on it, it splashes away and a new fish swims in.
description:
Fishy is a simple game for cats. A fish swims around the screen, cruising, hovering and darting. When your cat's paw lands on it, the fish vanishes in a splash and a new one swims in from the edge.

MADE FOR CATS
• Big, bright fish that move in bursts and pauses, the way cats like to hunt
• Near misses make the fish dart away
• Goldfish, koi and more, in different colours
• Every few minutes the fish swims off and a new one arrives, even if nobody catches it

CAT-PROOFED
• Full screen, with no buttons, menus or pop-ups for paws to hit
• The screen stays on while it plays
• On recent iPadOS and iOS versions, swipes from the screen edge need a second swipe, so stray paws are less likely to leave the app. For a determined cat, turn on Guided Access in Settings › Accessibility.

APPLE TV
On Apple TV, Fishy turns your TV into a pond: a fish swims about, and every few minutes it swims off and another takes its place.

FREE, WITH NO ADS
No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts and no data collected. Just a fish.

Please keep an eye on your cat while it plays, and consider a screen protector for enthusiastic hunters.
reviewNotes:
Fishy is a game for cats. A fish swims around the screen; touching it (with a paw, or a finger) makes it splash away and a new fish swims in from an edge. Every few minutes a fish also swims off by itself and is replaced. There are deliberately no buttons or menus, so a cat can't leave the game by accident.

On Apple TV there is nothing to interact with: it shows the fish swimming, with a new one arriving every few minutes.

No sign-in, no network access, no data collected.
